title: Ijwi rinyura mu bihanamanga
intro: Tekereza ikibaya aho amazu yaciwe mu bitare, kandi ikirere gihora cyibutsa umuburo utitaweho. Abantu bahoze batera imbere hano, bahiriwe ariko bagasuzugura, kugeza igihe ikimenyetso cyagaragaye mu rutare bizeraga.
clues: Twari abantu bacukuye amazu meza mu misozi, twumva dufite umutekano mu mazu yacu y’amabuye.
Twabaga mu gihugu cy'ibibaya n'amabuye, gifite ubusitani n'amasoko.
Intumwa yaturutse muri twe yaraje, iduhamagarira kureka imana zacu z'ibinyoma tugasenga Umuremyi umwe rukumbi w'ukuri.
Twashyizeho ikintu cy’ingenzi mu kwemera: ikimenyetso cyihariye cyava mu mabuye twacukuye.
Ubwo ingamiya y’ingore yasezeranyijwe yagaragaraga ivuye mu rutare, ikimenyetso gisobanutse neza, abayobozi bacu barabyanze kandi barayitema nubwo hari umuburo w’amakuba yari yegereje.
Nyuma y'iminsi itatu twakoze igikorwa cyacu, urusaku rw'inkuba rwarumvikanaga mu kibaya, maze duhinduka amatongo, amazu yacu ahinduka imva zacu.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
